title: Iterated blow-ups of a zero-scale limit at a point of the unit ball are again zero-scale limits of blow-ups of T (the (IBL) membership step)
statement: Assume (IBL) — verbatim the frozen type of the registered dependency iterated_blowup_limit of the grandparent node blowup_class: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ U, x_i → x, λ_i > 0 with λ_i → 0, S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), y ∈ ℝ^P, s_k > 0 with s_k → 0 and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P): if there are δ > 0 and Γ with M_{B_ρ(x′)}(T) ≤ ofReal(Γρⁿ) for all x′ ∈ B_δ(x) and 0 < ρ < δ, blowUp T x_i λ_i ⇀ S and blowUp S y s_k ⇀ C (ConvergesWeakly), then there is a strictly increasing φ with blowUp T (x_{φ(k)} + λ_{φ(k)}•y) (λ_{φ(k)}s_k) ⇀ C. Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), z ∈ ℝ^P, r ∈ ℝ, S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), points c_i ∈ ℝ^P and scales t_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ), and b ∈ U, such that dist(c_i, z) < r − t_i for every i, t_i → 0, c_i → b, blowUp T c_i t_i ⇀ S in ℝ^P (ConvergesWeakly), and there are δ > 0 and Γ ∈ ℝ with M_{B_ρ(x′)}(T) ≤ ofReal(Γρⁿ) for all x′ ∈ B_δ(b) and 0 < ρ < δ. Let y ∈ ℝ^P with ‖y‖ < 1, s_k > 0 (k ∈ ℕ) with s_k → 0, and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with blowUp S y s_k ⇀ C. Then there are points c′_k ∈ ℝ^P and scales t′_k > 0 (k ∈ ℕ) such that dist(c′_k, z) < r − t′_k for every k, t′_k → 0, c′_k → b and blowUp T c′_k t′_k ⇀ C.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (y : Euclid P) (ss : ℕ → ℝ) (hss : ∀ k, 0 < ss k) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto ss atTop (𝓝 0) → (∃ δ Γ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' ∈ ball x δ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → T.massOn (ball x' ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * ρ ^ n)) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (xs i) (lams i) (hlams i).ne') S → ConvergesWeakly (fun k => blowUp S y (ss k) (hss k).ne') C → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun k => blowUp T (xs (φ k) + lams (φ k) • y) (lams (φ k) * ss k) (mul_pos (hlams (φ k)) (hss k)).ne') C) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (z : Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (cs : ℕ → Euclid P) (ts : ℕ → ℝ) (hts : ∀ i, 0 < ts i) (b y : Euclid P) (ss : ℕ → ℝ) (hss : ∀ k, 0 < ss k) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen U → b ∈ U → (∀ i, dist (cs i) z < r - ts i) → Tendsto ts atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto cs atTop (𝓝 b) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (cs i) (ts i) (hts i).ne') S → (∃ δ Γ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' ∈ ball b δ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → T.massOn (ball x' ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * ρ ^ n)) → ‖y‖ < 1 → Tendsto ss atTop (𝓝 0) → ConvergesWeakly (fun k => blowUp S y (ss k) (hss k).ne') C → ∃ (cs' : ℕ → Euclid P) (ts' : ℕ → ℝ) (hts' : ∀ i, 0 < ts' i), (∀ i, dist (cs' i) z < r - ts' i) ∧ Tendsto ts' atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto cs' atTop (𝓝 b) ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (cs' i) (ts' i) (hts' i).ne') C
